verdict: A very close rebuild where every block sits within a few pixels and all the content is there; the main gaps are the iOS glass effects (no white fade or frosted blur behind the tab bar, so row 3 and the Star Academy logo show fully) and uneven, too-wide letter spacing; well structured, with templates for every repeated row.

top_defects.where: bottom of the feed, behind the tab bar
top_defects.what: the reference fades the feed to white under a frosted Liquid Glass bar: row 3 'Star Academy (France)' is pale grey and its logo is cut and faded, and the text behind the bar is heavily blurred. The render shows row 3 in full black with a full-color rank circle and logo, and the bar is only slightly translucent (bg-white/85 with no fade overlay)

top_defects.where: game card text, 'Which came first?', segmented control, tab labels
top_defects.what: the tracking overrides (-0.43/-0.23/+0.3 px) give uneven glyph spacing ('premier essai', 'soute rrain'). Bold titles are too wide: 'Which came first?' ends at about x=1880 vs 1870 equivalent and is visibly spaced, and 'Community', 'Activity' and 'Play today's game' are spaced too. Baselines sit 1 to 3 px low
an outlined account_circle where the reference has the filled person-in-circle glyph (solid head and shoulders)
a Material calendar_month with binder rings, 20 px; the reference uses a flat, wider calendar with a grid of dots and no rings
the cellular bars are about 25 % smaller than the reference's (10.5 vs about 13 pt tall), and the Home glyph is Material's filled house without the SF chimney and door

top_defects.where: segmented control and selected Home tab
top_defects.what: the track has no white glass rim or outline (the reference shows a 1 to 2 px light border). The selected Home tab is #3366cc instead of the measured #2975bf

top_defects.where: tab bar labels and card text
top_defects.what: the tab labels sit about 3 px (1 pt) lower than in the reference, and the card text lines run 1 to 2 px low. The heatmap's bottom row cells reach a meanDiff of 13 to 18

top_defects.where: section header overflow dots, tab bar template
top_defects.what: the overflow icon is recolored with a CSS filter chain instead of a real colored vector. The template data injects class strings ({{color}}, {{hl}}, {{titleClass}}, {{imgClass}}), and 160 arbitrary values are used

strengths: Every block (status bar, nav buttons, segmented control, Today, toast, Games and Top read sections, cards, tab bar, search button) is within a few pixels of the reference, and all the text matches exactly, accents and truncation included
The repeated rows are templates with data: the 2 game options, the 3 top-read rows and the 4 tabs
The real assets are used and cropped as in the reference: the W logo, the overflow dots, the France map, Nixon, Pablo Pagis and the Star Academy logo
